p1.finding: The bounded advance predicate's genesis branch never anchors adjacency to the genesis sentinel. The accepted design (design.md:115) requires the predicate to enforce 'Adjacency (genesis sentinel or exactly one adjacent settled-v1)'; the settled-v1 arm correctly pins priorCheckpointDigest === predecessor.candidateDigest (creator-transition-advance.ts:180-181), and both legacy carriers pin their genesis sentinels exactly (creator-transition-advance.ts:508 and :578), but the settlement genesis arm accepts ANY 64-hex priorCheckpointDigest with priorCheckpointKind 'genesis' at closedEpoch 0. The exported CREATOR_AUTHOR_SETTLEMENT_GENESIS_SENTINEL is referenced nowhere in packages or tests, and the corrected RED actively pins the loose behavior: the genesis fixture uses 'f'.repeat(64) and expects ok:true, with no mutation case covering a non-sentinel genesis digest. Because the opener is deliberately shape-only on predecessor fields, this predicate is the sole enforcement point, so the checkpoint chain root is left unanchored and the signed executable contract now entrenches the deviation for every later slice.
p1.evidence: packages/node/src/internal/creator-transition-advance.ts:159-170 (genesis branch omits the sentinel check); packages/protocol-v3/src/creator-author-issuance-frontiers.ts:444 (dead sentinel export); tests/d110c-0c1f5b0a-settlement-codec-red.test.ts:563-569 (non-sentinel 'f'*64 pinned as accepted); .logs/d110c-0c1f5b0r-design-3a156aca/design.md:115
p1.requiredFix: In inspectCreatorAuthorSettlementAdvance's predecessor===null branch, additionally require Reflect.get(proposed,'priorCheckpointDigest') === CREATOR_AUTHOR_SETTLEMENT_GENESIS_SENTINEL (imported from the settlement codec). Update the RED genesis fixture to use the real sentinel, add a mutation case rejecting a non-sentinel genesis digest, and pin the sentinel's exact hex value in the focused suite.
